criterion: Exists two already fresh-feasible NMS-native candidates in different native W/D families, each within stated full archived B/I reprojection level, and centroid separation>5cm. No reference pose/error is used.
limits: 2/3/6pixel RMS and maxeffectiveMah3 are descriptive levels, not calibrated noise guarantees or selected runtime thresholds.
ArchivedBI include revoked partial full-coordinate archives; this is a correspondence ambiguity diagnostic, not a claim they remain precise point measurements.
Finite proposal-bank existence is not proof of exhaustive/global ambiguity; absence is not uniqueness. Depth/family-reference limitations remain unchanged.
